title: Terrain flow (HAND, no training) against the official flood zones, DANA of 29 Oct 2024, 10 towns of L'Horta Sud and Chiva
note: Written with SI assistance (Claude Code), reviewed by the team.
rules: docs/STREETS.md, section Rules (committed before any score: git log docs/STREETS.md)

scored_pixels.rule: cell centre in one of the 10 municipalities, in the area at least one EMSR773 product analysed, not permanent water (ESA WorldCover 2021 class 80)

checks.note_without_hand: cells whose flow path leaves the grid before it meets a drainage cell; they rank last in the equal-area cut and are never flood-prone in method 2

diagnostics.what: HAND (bare terrain, drainage above 0.5 km2) of the flooded cells, the flood traces, the graded buildings and all scored cells, and the HAND at which the equal-area cut stops

land_needed_for_the_official_hit_rate.what: descriptive only: the terrain ranking (bare HAND, per town) with every town's budget scaled by the same factor until it catches as much as the official union

simulation.label: SIMULATED
simulation.engine: numba (pipeline/inertial_kernel.py, same scheme as pipeline.inertial, checked in tests)
simulation.infiltration: none (all rain runs off: an upper bound)
simulation.rain_source: Perez Cueva et al. (2025), Investigaciones Geograficas 84, 9-29, doi:10.14198/INGEO.30056, Tables 5 and 6

observed.source: CHJ, Informe del episodio de lluvias y avenidas del 28 de octubre al 4 de noviembre de 2024 (15 Jan 2025), table 2.1, Rambla del Poyo at the A-3, Riba-roja: last reading before the sensor was lost

gauge_check.note: a check only: nothing in the model was adjusted to it

dtm_2015_0722.aggregation: mean of 5 x 5 cells, nodata if half or fewer are valid

dtm_2015_0721.aggregation: mean of 5 x 5 cells, nodata if half or fewer are valid

worldcover_2021.note: window of the 10 m tile N39W003

terrain.lake_rule: WorldCover class 80 bodies of at least 1 km2 (8-connected)

flood_depth.label: ESTIMATED from the flood outline and terrain (FwDET rule, Cohen et al. 2018), not measured; says nothing about future storms
flood_depth.method: water surface of each flooded cell = ground of its nearest flood-edge cell; depth = surface - ground, at least 0; edges only where the flood touches mapped dry land with terrain that is not permanent water; no smoothing (docs/STREETS.md)

dana_2024_horta_sud.outline: EMSR773 maximum observed extent (flooded area plus flood traces, three products), whole grid
dana_2024_horta_sud.terrain: ICV MDT 1 m 2015 averaged to 5 m (not filled)

check_against_water_marks.source: ICV DANA2024.ZonasInundadas.AlturaAgua.* (UPV, IVE, SGRT, town halls): water heights surveyed after the flood

edges_in_the_ten_towns.note: checked after seeing the errors; building walls are not the main source of error

dana_adam_2026_pego_oliva.outline: EMSR935 (data/labels/pego_oliva_emsr935_flood.geojson), flooded area plus flood traces
dana_adam_2026_pego_oliva.terrain: ICV MDT 1 m 2015 sheet 0796 averaged to 5 m (not filled)

check_against_water_marks.result: no check: no surveyed mark lies inside the EMSR935 outline

water_marks_layer.what: water heights surveyed after the 2024 flood (MEASURED), every mark above 0 m whose 5 m cell lies in one of the 10 municipalities; coordinates in WGS84 with 5 decimals (about 1 m)
water_marks_layer.not_exported: marks on the analysis grid outside the 10 municipalities (no town for them here)
